description: This file defines SwiftUI components and associated Cocoa interop code for managing a transcript text view and a vibrant label in a macOS application. It includes UI representations, delegate handling, and custom view classes involved in text editing, display, and user interactions within the app.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: Handles NSTextView delegate methods to synchronize text changes and editing states with SwiftUI bindings.

classes.name: ClickCatcher
classes.description: A custom NSView that captures mouse clicks to trigger tap actions.

classes.name: TranscriptNSTextView
classes.description: A customized NSTextView subclass that manages key events and focus callbacks for transcript editing.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Coordinator instance for managing NSTextView delegate callbacks.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures the NSScrollView containing the custom text view.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView and its content when SwiftUI state changes.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures the NSView for the vibrant label with action handling.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates label content and appearance as needed.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse click events to trigger tap actions.

methods.name: becomeFirstResponder
methods.description: Overrides to handle beginning of editing state.

methods.name: resignFirstResponder
methods.description: Overrides to handle end of editing state.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.description: Custom key event handler to process Return, Escape, and Command+Return actions for text input.
